function matmult1(A, x)
    m, n = size(A)
    y = zeros(m)
    for i in 1:m
        for j in 1:n
            y[i] += A[i,j] * x[j]
        end
    end
    y
end

x = [10., 0, 0, 0]
matmult1(A, x)

# Dot product

function matmult2(A, x)
    m, n = size(A)
    y = zeros(m)
    for i in 1:m
        y[i] = A[i,:]' * x
    end
    y
end

matmult2(A, x)

function matmult3(A, x)
    m, n = size(A)
    y = zeros(m)
    for j in 1:n
        y += A[:, j] * x[j]
    end
    y
end

matmult3(A, x)

function vander(x, k=nothing)
    if isnothing(k)
        k = length(x)
    end
    m = length(x)
    V = ones(m, k)
    for j in 2:k
        V[:, j] = V[:, j-1] .* x
    end
    V
end

V = vander(x, 4)
